mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_canvas_run WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_canvas_run_withdrawal WHERE scope_key = #{scope} AND request_id = #{request})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_run_withdrawal(scope_key, request_id, canvas_id, created_at) VALUES (#{scope}, #{request}, #{canvasId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope_key = scope_key

INSERT INTO afv_canvas_run(id, canvas_id, plan_id, actor_user_id, actor_team_id, scope_key, request_id, request_hash, context_json, snapshot_json, deadline_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.canvasId}, #{row.planId}, #{row.actorUserId}, #{row.actorTeamId}, #{row.scopeKey}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.requestHash}, #{row.contextJson}, #{row.snapshotJson}, #{row.deadlineAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_run SET status = #{status}, error_msg = #{error}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
